items.title: DevOps Engineer
items.text:
Department: Engineering
Employment: Full-Time
Location: Ikoyi, Lagos, Nigeria

Who we are

Chowdeck is an on-demand delivery service for Africa. We help vendors deliver food, medicine, and groceries seamlessly while also providing customers with a platform to order from their favourite vendors.

At Chowdeck, we deeply value growth, excellence, speed, and empathy. Our team is a tight-knit team of creative problem solvers who are smart, kind and committed to helping each other grow.

Where you come in

We're looking for a DevOps Engineer to join our team in building and maintaining the infrastructure that powers our delivery platform and internal systems at scale.

You'll work closely with Backend Engineers, Data teams, and Product teams to improve reliability, scalability, deployment processes, observability, and operational efficiency across our systems and services. Our infrastructure currently leverages AWS, Google Cloud, Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and other modern tooling.

We're looking for articulate people who are curious, empathetic, and kind and are looking to continue to grow their careers at a fast-growing tech startup that cares deeply about personal and professional development.

In this role, you'll be required to:

- Design, build, and maintain scalable cloud infrastructure and deployment systems
- Improve system reliability, performance, availability, and security across services
- Build and maintain CI/CD pipelines and deployment workflows
- Improve monitoring, logging, alerting, and observability across our systems
- Automate infrastructure provisioning and operational processes
- Collaborate with engineers across the company to improve developer experience and platform efficiency
- Support incident response, troubleshooting, and production issue resolution
- Help improve infrastructure standards, tooling, and operational best practices

You're perfect for the role if you:

- Have strong professional experience managing cloud infrastructure and production systems
- Have experience with AWS, Google Cloud, Docker, Kubernetes, or similar technologies
- Have strong knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and Infrastructure as Code tooling
- Can troubleshoot complex infrastructure and networking issues
- Care deeply about reliability, scalability, security, and performance
- Can write clean scripts and automation tooling
- Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
- Thrive in fast-paced startup environments with evolving priorities

Beyond the paycheck, Chowdeck employees get:

- Full medical coverage
- Smart, kind colleagues invested in your growth
- Housing Assistance
- Transport Assistance
- Lunch allowance

Chowdeck is an equal-opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We’re committed to providing employees with a work environment that is progressive and open-minded. Our employment philosophy is to hire the best people and empower them to do the best work of their lives. Employment decisions are based on business needs and individual merit without regard to race, color, religion, ethnicity, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, gender, or age.

items.title: Brand & Graphic Designer (Intermediate)
items.text:
Department: Brand & Marketing
Employment: Full-Time
Location: Accra, Ghana

Who we are

Chowdeck is an on-demand delivery service for Africa. We deliver food, medicine, groceries and other packages seamlessly while providing customers with a platform to order from their favourite vendors.
At Chowdeck, we deeply value growth, excellence, speed, and empathy. Our team is a tight-knit group of creative problem solvers who are smart, kind, and committed to helping each other grow.

Where you come in

As a Brand & Graphic Designer at Chowdeck, you will help shape and maintain the visual identity of our brand. You’ll work on a variety of design projects, ensuring our brand remains engaging and consistent across all platforms. Your designs will play a key role in how customers connect with Chowdeck, from marketing campaigns to in-app visuals.

This is an intermediate-level role, suited for a designer who has moved beyond the basics and is ready to take on more ownership. You'll bring 2–3 years of solid experience to the table, work independently on briefs, and collaborate closely with other designers and cross-functional teams to bring ideas to life and scale them. Your voice will be heard, and your work will make meaningful contributions to the business.

We're looking for a creative and detail-oriented designer who can bring ideas to life as well as scale them. If you have a strong portfolio, a passion for branding, and a problem-solving mindset, we’d love to hear from you.

You’ll collaborate with our cross-functional teams to bring ideas to life while working closely with other designers on the team. You'll work side by side with a tight-knit team of creative problem solvers, empathetic, kind who’ll value you, give you the opportunity to meet high expectations, and actively create a supportive, nurturing space to accelerate your career.

Our team is small but highly accomplished, so your voice will be heard, and your ideas will make meaningful contributions to the business.

In this role you'll be required to:

- Create visually stunning and on-brand designs for digital and physical channels, including social media, email campaigns, billboards, packaging, and in-app content.
- Collaborate with the marketing, content, and cross-functional teams to develop creative assets that enhance customer engagement.
- Support brand consistency by following and contributing to design guidelines and templates.
- Work closely with other designers to scale already designed projects to other formats and maintain a cohesive branding.
- Manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
- Tailor design and communications to resonate with the culture and values of the cities we are present in, and will launch in, ensuring our people feel closer and more valued.
- Stay updated with the latest design trends, tools, and techniques to keep Chowdeck’s visuals fresh and engaging.
- Ensure all designs comply with copyright and data protection laws.
- Represent Chowdeck at self-hosted and external events

You’re perfect for the role if you:

- a hustler.
- fun and bustling with ideas
- have a minimum of 2-3 years experience in brand and graphic design, with a proven track record of delivering beautiful and impactful designs.
- have a deep understanding of branding principles and how to apply them across various mediums.
- possess a strong portfolio showcasing diverse projects, from digital to print.
- are proficient in design tools such as Adobe Creative Suite (Photoshop, Illustrator, InDesign) and Figma.
- have excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to articulate design decisions.
- detail-oriented and organized, capable of managing multiple projects and meeting deadlines.
- collaborative and enjoy working in a team environment while taking ownership of your projects.
- have a strong understanding of Ghanaian and African cultures, ensuring designs are relatable and resonate deeply with our audience.
- have a deep and unrelenting focus on customer satisfaction and experience.
- motivated by the opportunity to improve customer experiences through creative design and provide a seamless food delivery experience.

Beyond the paycheck, Chowdeck employees get:

- MacBook for your work
- Smart, kind colleagues invested in your growth
- Opportunities for rapid career progression
- Lunch allowance
- Ride credits for transport

Chowdeck is an equal opportunity employer and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any kind. We’re committed to providing employees with a work environment that is progressive and open-minded. Our employment philosophy is to hire the best people and empower them to do the best work of their lives. Employment decisions are based on business needs and individual merit without regard to race, color, religion, ethnicity, sexual orientation, nationality, marital status, gender or age.
